title: Introduce pluggable presubmit lint adapters and dependency minifier
author: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Add a pluggable presubmit lint adapter layer and a companion dependency-minifier tool that reduces dev-dep surface for fast local and CI boot times. Motivation: our presubmit image/toolchain is growing; many repos run heavy devdeps in presubmit which increases CI setup time and cache churn. This PR extracts an adapter interface for lint/test runners so we can add language-specific optimizations without bloating the core runner, and introduces a Rust-based dependency-minifier that emits a trimmed package manifest for CI/presubmit environments.

What this PR does (checklist):
- [x] Introduce presubmit/adapters/* (Go interfaces + TypeScript shim) and wire up existing linters to the adapter registry.
- [x] Implement two adapters: nodejs-fast and python-fast; both opt-in via repository .presubmit.yaml.
- [x] Add dep-minifier binary (small Rust tool) and a devcontainer/CI step that runs it to create a trimmed lockfile for presubmit jobs.
- [x] Update CI templates to use trimmed manifests for fastpath presubmit lanes.
- [x] Add migration docs, examples in redwood-quickstarts, and a rollout plan with canary repos.

Migration/rollout notes: The feature is opt-in. Repos can switch by adding a single line to .presubmit.yaml. We will enable for 10 internal repos as a canary, monitor presubmit latency and cache hit metrics, then expand. Fallback: adapter registry includes a passthrough adapter that runs legacy behavior when bug-triage label is present.

Design notes: The adapter interface is intentionally small (Init, RunCheck, RunFix, Teardown). Adapters are loaded by name from the presubmit registry; this keeps CI templates generic and allows language teams to own optimizations. The dep-minifier analyzes lockfile + package manifest, removes dev-only transitive entries that are not referenced by presubmit tasks, and outputs a CI-specific lockfile. In local dev, the minifier can be run with --validate to ensure parity with full lockfile.

Testing & verification: unit tests added for adapter registry, E2E presubmit smoke runs in the redwood monorepo, dep-minifier verified against a sample monorepo with mixed node/python services. See commits for test details.

Related: ENG-2345 (presubmit cost initiative), SUP-9123 (support ticket on flaky presubmit images).
